title: Split Array Largest Sum
description:
Given an integer array nums and an integer k, split nums into k non-empty contiguous subarrays.

Write an algorithm to minimize the largest sum among these k subarrays.

Return the minimized largest sum of the split.

examples.explanation: There are four ways to split nums into two subarrays. The best way is to split it into [7,2,5] and [10,8], where the largest sum among the two subarrays is only 18.
The best split is [1,2,3,4] and [5], giving a largest sum of 10, or [1,2,3] and [4,5] giving 9.
Each element becomes its own subarray, so the largest sum is 4.

approach: Binary search on the answer. Any candidate largest-sum limit between max(nums) and sum(nums) is feasible if a greedy left-to-right pass can cover nums using at most k parts: extend the current part until adding the next value would exceed the limit, then start a new part. Feasibility is monotone in the limit, so binary search converges on the smallest feasible limit. Time is O(n log(sum(nums)-max(nums))) and auxiliary space is O(1).
